name: screenshot-to-code
description: Drop in a screenshot and convert it to clean code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue)
one_liner: Upload a screenshot or design mockup and get working website code back — HTML, React, Vue, or Tailwind.
buyer: A freelance web developer or agency that wants to turn client mockups into a working site in hours instead of days.
business_use_cases: A freelancer converts a client's Figma screenshot into a working prototype in an afternoon instead of a week.
A no-code agency offers 'design to live site' as a rush service using this as the first-draft generator.
A marketing team turns competitor landing pages into internal test variants for A/B testing.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a fast-turnaround 'screenshot to live website' freelance service, charging per page.
Build a subscription SaaS wrapper targeting a specific niche, like real-estate landing pages.

steal_this: Offer a $150 'turn your mockup into a live site by tomorrow' service on Fiverr this weekend.
